reading_receipts.detail: Full body reviewed. Strict canonical JSON reparse is bounded at 2 MiB; current evaluator/domain source bytes are framed into an implementation digest. Fixture evaluation requires exact bank/spec DTOs, unique selected spec IDs, matching case/spec sets, positive and negative controls and two distinct context_key strings. Distinct labels do not establish evidential independence. Predicate.matches is called twice per case (observed_hit and passed), despite the once-per-case docstring; mathematical adequacy depends on the pure predicate owner and supplied cases. Activation only filters selected verified-registry specs within profile subject scopes; authority admission is external. Reusable version-bound finite regression replay, not general learned detector accuracy.

Full body reviewed. Fresh compiler callback, catalog canonical roundtrip, fixture replay and exact subject reconstruction precede predicate evaluation; receipt binds hashes and computed outcome and explicitly holds activation/unadmitted. Optional signed instruction path recompiles/selects a fixed two-operation route and delegates SSH verification using caller trust root. Finite controls and a clean subject do not grant registry admission or guard replacement. Public receipt constructors bind content but are not unforgeable runtime capabilities. No key/signature/provider execution performed.
